method: Read-only inspection of one existing local PostgreSQL snapshot. Alternate baseline-commit and working-tree projections three times; include moderation filtering, structure projection, compact JSON encoding and gzip level 4. Assert every decoded page is deeply equal. These measurements exclude WAN latency and browser rendering and are not production timings.

hydration.method: Same structural index and selected IDs; calls to the local HTTP snapshot API using the old and new hydration clients. JSON bytes are decoded sizes, not compressed wire sizes. HTTP timings are single samples and exclude browser layout.

changes: Start structural catalog when the first window arrives, concurrently with its delta synchronization; preserve the full-snapshot path.
Preserve shared sanitized record identities so compact transport removes duplicate relations.
Resolve exact body IDs in batches of at most 200 with at most 3 concurrent requests; omit redundant window context.
Restrict JSON processing to referenced query candidates and use already-loaded target revisions for stance lookup.
